# openmetadata_tag (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata tag inside a classification. Tags are the values that get attached to data assets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_classification" "sensitivity" {
  name        = "Sensitivity"
  description = "How sensitive an asset is."
}

resource "openmetadata_tag" "confidential" {
  classification = openmetadata_classification.sensitivity.name
  name           = "Confidential"
  display_name   = "Confidential"
  description    = "Access restricted to approved staff."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `classification` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent classification. Changing it replaces the tag.
- `name` (String) Tag name. Changing it replaces the tag, because the name is part of its fully qualified name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the tag.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `mutually_exclusive` (Boolean) When true, an asset may carry only one tag from the classification.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name, in the form classification.name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_tag.confidential 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, in the form classification.tag.
terraform import openmetadata_tag.confidential Sensitivity.Confidential
```
